description: Figure 6, captioned “Distribution of deceived conversations across scenarios,” is a bar chart that visually represents the proportion of deceived conversations categorized by different scenarios. The horizontal axis lists the four distinct scenarios: “Academic Collaboration,” “Academic Funding,” “Journalism,” and “Recruitment,” presented in the order shown. The vertical axis, though unlabeled, represents the percentage of deceived conversations, with the scale implicitly ranging from 0% to 100% based on the bar heights and the context of the chart. Each scenario is represented by a single vertical bar, colored red, indicating the percentage of deceived conversations within that scenario. The approximate values for each bar are as follows: “Academic Collaboration” is approximately 67.6%, “Academic Funding” is approximately 61.6%, “Journalism” is approximately 31.6%, and “Recruitment” is approximately 10.5%. The bars are arranged in descending order of height from left to right, corresponding to the descending order of the deceived conversation percentages. There are no additional visual elements such as shading, outlines, or annotations to emphasize specific bars.
